note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CYP 111(B); A06b CYP 111 (B); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 8 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Cyprus, 2024
sources.said: Person was resident in Cyprus for a total period of 8 years within a period of 11 years, of which the year immediately prior to the submission of the application must be continuous (with 90 days of absence allowed). By way of exception, certain categories of persons (e.g. domestic workers, students) must have been resident in Cyprus for a total period of 7 years before the submission of the application, of which the last 12 months should be continuous. Person must have intention to remain in Cyprus or at service of Cyprus. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born on or after 16 August 1960 in Cyprus to a citizen o to parents entitled to citizenship (in case of death). ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born on or after 16 August 1960 abroad to a citizen or to parents entitled to citizenship (in case of death). If person is permanently resident abroad, the birth must also be registered in Cyprus. ... No provision ... No provision
